subject.title: fix(gateway): deliver OAuth authorization URLs to non-terminal clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept `presentsAuthChallenge` as a plugin-facing WizardPrompter capability and treat auth-presenting RPC clients as remote/manual for provider OAuth routing?
rationale: The code shape is a plausible fix, but it changes a compatibility-sensitive auth-provider contract that affects plugin authors and non-terminal setup behavior, which needs maintainer intent rather than deterministic cleanup.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
options.body: Require inspectable companion proof and a clean rebase, then accept the new prompter capability as the shared auth-challenge seam.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Helper Only
options.body: Reject the broader provider-auth routing contract and ask for a smaller fix limited to the shared OAuth helper paths that already have a URL callback.

options.title: Pause Behind RPC Parity Umbrella
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the broader wizard RPC parity issue settles one client-visible contract for auth, progress, and setup artifacts.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
recommendation.body: Require inspectable companion proof and a clean rebase, then accept the new prompter capability as the shared auth-challenge seam.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to Peter Steinberger as the strongest current owner for the shared provider auth and wizard seam touched by this contract decision.
